title: Bruce Ou – Private Market Investing at GroveStreet (EP.347)

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Bruce Ou is the Managing Partner of GroveStreet.
reader_summary.overview: Bruce Ou is the Managing Partner of GroveStreet, a boutique firm that has invested $10 billion in the private markets on behalf of fourteen institutional clients. GroveStreet specializes in managers that transform companies in venture capital, growth equity, and middle market buyouts. Our conversation canvasses Bruce's emigration from China, thoughts on middle market buyouts, venture capital, and growth equity investing, opportunities in China, and co-investments.
